caveats: Town mismatch: the batch places three businesses in New Brunswick, but their own sites put them elsewhere — J Angeles Painting is based in Jackson and markets Monmouth/Ocean counties (its van shows the batch's 732-522-6528 number), Handyman Roberto is in Monmouth Junction serving the Princeton corridor, and Advance Home Renovations is an apartment address in New Brunswick with a 973 area-code phone. Their local ranking potential for New Brunswick searches is therefore limited (inference).
Google Maps served a 'limited view' without review counts, so review totals come from Birdeye or Angi where noted; the Google star rating itself was read directly from each profile.

Five of these sites (miguelspainter.com, jangelespainting.com, grizzliesconstruction.com, monmouthjunctionhandyman.com, welchezcontractors.com) share the same decorative emoji in every title tag, which suggests a common local web/SEO vendor (inference from a repeated signature, not confirmed).
Two entries have no reliable contact path (Roman Custom Painting, Nafe Construction) and two are closed (Harriott's, Nafe), so roughly half of this batch is not addressable as a prospect.
Review quotes are paraphrased in a few words; several aggregator pages were unclaimed copies of Google data and may lag reality.
Scores are relative within this batch: gap_size 5 means 'almost nothing usable online', 1 means 'nearly done'.
One correction of my own earlier reading: a Google profile link is not proof a site is live — Advance's listed domain fails DNS, so 'no website' rather than 'has website' is the finding.
data_gaps: Google Business Profile claim status is not visible to a visitor, so 'claimed/complete' is inferred from photos, descriptions and 'Add missing information' prompts rather than confirmed.

Angi, YellowPages and BuildZoom returned HTTP 403 to direct fetches; their figures (Angi ratings for Welchez 5.0/6 and Grizzlies 4.5/12, BuildZoom licence status for Handyman Roberto and Advance) come from search-result summaries and were not read on the page itself.
Google review counts could not be read for any business because Maps showed a limited view; Nafe, Harriott's, Calvo and Miguel's review counts come from Birdeye only.
Nafe Construction's closure rests on one aggregator status plus an absent Google listing; no state registry or notice was checked.
No job postings, enquiry volumes or internal tooling were visible for any business, so operations findings are limited to what websites and listings show.
Miguel's Painting's Yelp page was linked from its site but not opened, and its Angi listing was not readable, so those review counts are unknown.
